slug: 源尘第一百四十一章北隙
content_zh:
第一章看见价格的人
陆尘能看到万物“存在”的价格。
这是一份诅咒，而非馈赠。
清晨的第一缕光还未刺破栖霞镇的薄雾，陆尘先看见了别的。
他睁开眼的瞬间，世界“炸”开了。
不是声音，是信息。海啸般的信息流蛮横地冲进他的意识，带着冰冷的标签和闪烁的数字。
他“看”见头顶的房梁——那根被虫蛀过、用铁箍加固的老榆木，内部维系结构的源能正像沙漏里的细沙般缓慢流逝。旁边悬着一行半透明的字：【结构稳定性剩余：47年3个月8天】。字是淡灰色的，随着他呼吸微微颤动。
他“看”见窗外那棵百年老槐。树冠里燃烧着蓬勃的绿色火焰，那是生命源能在枝叶间奔流。每片叶子都在进行精密的交易：叶绿脉络吸收晨光，转化为0.03单位光能，同时释放0.028单位清气，净损益+0.002单位。根系扎进地下三丈，正从一条丰沛的金色光河中汲取养分——那是栖霞镇的“基础源能流”，镇子活着的命脉。
他“看”见隔壁王叔开始劈柴。手臂肌肉收缩时，生命源能如火星迸溅，每一下劈砍消耗“今日基础代谢配额”的0.7%。王叔头顶浮着更大的数字：【自然寿数剩余：约38年】。数字末尾的小数点还在跳动，随着王叔一次稍重的呼吸，从“38年0月2天”变成了“38年0月1天17小时”。
声音也带着标签。鸡鸣是【领地宣告-能量消耗：低】，风声是【空气动能转移-源能扰动：微弱】，连自己心跳都是【生命维持系统运行-能耗：稳定】。
陆尘猛地闭眼。
冷汗顺着额角滑进鬓发。他攥紧粗糙的麻布被单，指节发白，用全部意志去做那件做了十年的事——推开一扇不存在的、重若千钧的石门。
“关上……给我关上……”他咬着牙，从齿缝里挤出气音。
像逆着洪流游泳。像用手去捂溃堤的裂缝。那些数字、标签、能量流起初挣扎着不肯退去，最后才不情不愿地模糊、淡化，让位给正常的、安宁的、属于“人”的视觉。
世界安静下来。
只有木屋的霉味，透进窗格的微光，和自己如擂鼓的心跳。
陆尘瘫在床上，大口喘气，像是刚跑完三十里山路。每次强行关闭“那种视野”，都像打了一场仗。医馆的柳婆婆说，这叫“重度源能感知过载”，是神魂受损的绝症。他每天早晚各服一次的“宁神散”，不是为了助他感知天地——恰恰相反，那碗苦得舌根发麻的药汤，是麻痹他感知的枷锁。
没有枷锁，他会疯。七岁那年之后，他就知道了。
“尘儿，起了没？”
温老的声音从门外传来，混着压抑的咳嗽。

陆尘一个激灵坐起身：“起了，师父！”
他快速套上打补丁的灰布短衫，用冷水抹了把脸。铜盆里的水映出一张清瘦的脸，十七八岁模样，眉眼干净，只是眼底下总有散不去的淡青——那是长期与“视野”搏斗的印记。最特别的是眼睛，瞳孔深处偶尔会闪过极淡的金色纹路，像星图碎影，转瞬即逝。
推开房门，补修坊特有的气味扑面而来。
陈年的木屑味、源能晶石粉末的微涩、机油、还有一点点铁锈和汗味。二十平见方的铺子堆得满满当当：缺了腿的源能灯、纹路暗淡的取暖器、彻底罢工的旧式传讯符盘……靠墙的木架上，分门别类放着导能线、基础源纹拓片、各种纯度的源能晶石碎块。
温老已经坐在工作台前了。
老人很瘦，背佝偻着，像一棵被风雪压弯的老松。他正用放大镜仔细端详一盏民用源能灯，花白的眉毛拧在一起。听见陆尘出来，他抬头，脸上皱纹舒展成一个温和的笑：“来，看看这个。陈婶昨晚送来的，说灯突然不亮了，铺子晚上没照明不行。”
陆尘接过灯。
很常见的“民用级-iii型”，黄铜灯座，琉璃灯罩，核心是一块鸽蛋大小的劣等光源石。普通人用，足够照亮十平米的小铺面了。
他手指抚过灯座内侧的源纹凹槽——那是引导源能、转化光热的基础回路。触感冰凉。
“我试了试，”温老咳嗽两声，指了指工作台上拆开的零件，“光源石没坏，导能线也没断。应该是回路本身出了问题，但具体哪儿断了，我这老眼……”
“我来吧，师父。”陆尘轻声说。
他在工作台前坐下，拿起那盏灯。深吸一口气，然后，极其小心地，将“那道门”推开一条缝隙。
只一条缝。
嗡——
世界再次变得“清晰”，但这次是可控的、聚焦的。他屏蔽了房梁的倒计时，屏蔽了窗外槐树的交易，屏蔽了一切无关信息。视野里只剩下手中这盏灯，和它内部那个损坏的、本应发光的能量路径。
他“看见”了。
三条断痕。不，严格说是“能量淤塞点”。源能从晶石流出，流到这三个位置时，像是遇到看不见的墙，徒劳地冲撞、逸散。回路本身没断，是刻画时源纹的“势”有了瑕疵，经年累月，形成了梗阻。

Chapter 1 The person who sees the price
Lu Chen can see the price of the "existence" of all things.
This is a curse, not a gift.
Before the first ray of light in the morning broke through the mist in Qixia Town, Lu Chen saw something else first.
The moment he opened his eyes, the world "exploded".
It's not a sound, it's a message. A tsunami-like flow of information rushed into his consciousness, carrying cold labels and flashing numbers.
He "saw" the beam above his head - the old elm wood that had been eaten by insects and reinforced with iron hoops. The source energy maintaining the structure inside was flowing slowly like fine sand in an hourglass. A line of translucent words hangs next to it: [Structural stability remaining: 47 years, 3 months and 8 days]. The words were light gray and vibrated slightly with his breathing.
He "saw" the century-old locust tree outside the window. There is a vigorous green flame burning in the crown of the tree, which is the source of life flowing among the branches and leaves. Each leaf is conducting a precise transaction: the green veins of the leaf absorb morning light and convert it into 0.03 units of light energy, while releasing 0.028 units of clean air, with a net profit and loss of +0.002 units. The roots penetrate three feet into the ground and are drawing nutrients from a rich golden river of light - that is the "basic energy flow" of Qixia Town, the lifeblood of the town's life.
He "saw" Uncle Wang next door starting to chop wood. When the arm muscles contract, the life source energy bursts out like sparks, and each chop consumes 0.7% of "today's basal metabolic quota". A bigger number floated above Uncle Wang's head: [Natural life span remaining: about 38 years]. The decimal point at the end of the number was still beating. With Uncle Wang's heavy breathing, it changed from "October 38, 2 days" to "October 38, 1 day and 17 hours."
Sounds also carry labels. The crowing of the cock is [Territorial Declaration - Energy Consumption: Low], the sound of the wind is [Air Kinetic Energy Transfer - Source Energy Disturbance: Weak], and even my own heartbeat is [Life Support System Operation - Energy Consumption: Stable].
Lu Chen closed his eyes suddenly.
Cold sweat slid down his forehead and into his temples. He gripped the rough linen sheets tightly, his knuckles turned white, and used all his will to do what he had been doing for ten years - push open a stone door that did not exist and was as heavy as a stone.
"Shut it... shut it for me..." He gritted his teeth and exhaled from between his teeth.
Like swimming against the current. It's like using your hands to cover the cracks in a broken embankment. Those numbers, labels, and energy flows struggled to recede at first, and finally reluctantly blurred and faded, giving way to normal, peaceful, and "human" vision.
The world quieted down.
There was only the musty smell of the wooden house, the dim light filtering through the windows, and my own heartbeat like a drum.
Lu Chen collapsed on the bed, gasping for air, as if he had just run a thirty-mile mountain road. Every time I forcefully close "that view," it's like fighting a battle. Grandma Liu from the medical clinic said that this is called "severe source energy perception overload" and it is a terminal disease in which the soul is damaged. The "Ningshen Powder" he takes once every morning and evening is not to help him perceive the world - on the contrary, the bowl of medicinal soup that is so bitter that it numbs the back of his tongue is a shackle to numb his perception.
Without shackles, he would go crazy. After the age of seven, he knew.
"Chen'er, are you up?"
Mr. Wen's voice came from outside the door, mixed with a suppressed cough.
Chase Lu sat up in excitement: "Get up, Master!"
He quickly put on his patched gray cloth shirt and wiped his face with cold water. The water in the copper basin reflected a thin face, looking about seventeen or eighteen years old, with clean eyebrows, but there was always a light blue under the eyes that would not go away - it was the mark of a long-term struggle with "vision". The most special thing is the eyes. Occasionally, very faint golden lines flash through the depths of the pupils, like the broken shadows of a star map, fleeting.
Pushing open the door, the unique smell of the repair shop hits your face.
The smell of old sawdust, the slight astringency of energy crystal powder, engine oil, and a little bit of rust and sweat. The 20-square-meter shop is full of piles: energy lamps with missing legs, heaters with dim patterns, old-fashioned messenger charms that are completely useless......On the wooden shelves against the wall, energy-conducting wires, rubbings of basic source patterns, and fragments of source energy crystals of various purity are placed in different categories.
Mr. Wen was already sitting at the workbench.
The old man was very thin, with a stooped back, like an old pine bent by the wind and snow. He was looking carefully at a civilian energy lamp with a magnifying glass, his gray eyebrows knitted together. Hearing Lu Chen come out, he looked up, and the wrinkles on his face stretched into a gentle smile: "Come, take a look at this. Aunt Chen sent it last night, saying that the lights suddenly stopped working, and the shop cannot be used without lighting at night."
Lu Chen took the light.
The very common "civilian grade-III type" has a brass lamp holder, a glass lampshade, and the core is an inferior light source stone the size of a pigeon egg. For ordinary people, it is enough to illuminate a small shop of ten square meters.
His fingers touched the groove of the source pattern on the inside of the lamp holder - that is the basic circuit that guides source energy and converts light and heat. Cool to the touch.
"I gave it a try," Mr. Wen coughed twice and pointed at the disassembled parts on the workbench. "The light source stone is not broken, and the energy conducting wire is not broken. There should be something wrong with the circuit itself, but where exactly is it broken? My old eyes..."
"I'll do it, Master." Lu Chen said softly.
He sat down at the workbench and picked up the lamp. Take a deep breath, and then, very carefully, push "the door" open a gap.
Just a seam.
Buzz——
The world becomes "clear" again, but this time it's controlled and focused. He blocked the countdown of the rafters, blocked the transaction of the locust tree outside the window, and blocked all irrelevant information. All that was left in his field of vision was the lamp in his hand, and the damaged energy path inside it that was supposed to shine.
He "saw" it.
Three broken marks. No, strictly speaking, it is an "energy stasis point." When the source energy flows from the crystal to these three locations, it seems to encounter an invisible wall, colliding and escaping in vain. The circuit itself is not broken, but the "potential" used to depict the source pattern is flawed, and over time, it has become blocked.
